breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still combines gamma-centered k-point grids with half shifts (e.g., '8x8x6 will be used, centered at Gamma with a half shift (0 0 0 1 1 1)' and '16x16x10 will be used, centered at Gamma with a half shift (0 0 0 1 1 1)'). This directly repeats the original contradictory instruction. The ground truth removes the 'half shift' / 'Monkhorst-Pack with half shift' language entirely, specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid. The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency.
